summary: Comprehensive testing of Dietary Preference feature in AI Weekly Meal Plan Generator. Backend API /api/weekly-plan/generate correctly accepts dietary_preference parameter and generates appropriate meals for all 5 dietary types. Frontend AIMealPlanGenerator component displays all 5 dietary options with icons and descriptions. Validation works correctly - error shown when dietary preference not selected.
